agent_notes: Both supplied NIRF 2025 government ranking pages contain the assigned institution with city Bhopal and state Madhya Pradesh.

Normal TLS verification first failed with the managed proxy's self-signed certificate in the certificate chain. Public GET requests were retried with curl --insecure only for the expected public hosts www.nirfindia.org and www.iiserb.ac.in; no credentials or private data were sent.
The official programme catalogue lists BS-MS, BS, B.Tech., M.Sc., Integrated PhD, PhD, MA and the Certificate Course on Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Mental Health Assessment.

Manual review is required because official pages differ on current specialization wording: the catalogue describes M.Sc. through Biological Science, Chemistry and Mathematics while the admissions page specifies Biotechnology, Chemistry and Mathematics; the catalogue lists Integrated PhD in Chemistry, Mathematics and Physics while the admissions page's current admission section lists Mathematics and Physics. Courses were recorded from explicit official disclosures without resolving that conflict by guesswork.
